scope.purpose: Govern multi-model collaboration, reference relationships, shared spatial coordination, and worksharing boundaries while preserving container ownership and downstream coordination integrity.
scope.tool_neutral_boundary: L4 defines required outcomes and authority boundaries. Revit Central/Local mechanics, worksets, and specific shared-coordinate commands remain L6 implementation guidance.

requirements.statement: Collaboration across models shall preserve model ownership, predictable interactions, and stable reference relationships between separately identified containers.
Discipline authoring models shall serve as the single source of truth for their modeled content and scope.
Changes in referenced models shall propagate through controlled container updates via CDE Shared state rather than ad-hoc file replacement.
Collaboration discussions, notifications, or conversational agreements shall not be construed as governance approval, sign-off, or acceptance.
Linked models shall function as read-only references; host authoring sessions shall not modify or borrow elements of a linked model.
All model links shall be recorded in the governed Link Registry prior to coordination intake.
Each project shall maintain a single, unambiguous shared spatial coordinate system across all participating disciplines.
The Standalone Coordination File BIM-STD-CF-001 shall be established and maintained by the Project BIM Manager as the sole authority for shared coordinates, levels, and grids.
The Standalone Coordination File shall not contain modeled physical building elements.
All discipline models shall reference the Standalone Coordination File and consume its approved spatial framework during initial model setup.

scope.implementation_note: For Revit implementation, discipline models acquire coordinates from BIM-STD-CF-001; peer-to-peer coordinate publication is not an equivalent authority path.

requirements.statement: Internal-origin alignment shall not be used as the governing basis for multi-model federation where a governed shared coordinate system exists.
Multi-user authoring environments shall enforce clear worksharing protocols to prevent concurrency collisions and unauthorized modifications.

provenance.migration_note: L4 S6 module migrated with curator decisions D-14 through D-17. Tool-specific Revit mechanics remain implementation-layer material and unresolved source gaps remain explicitly open.
